posts.content_md:
Somewhat similar to [these containers](http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=2132) mentioned by TomB, I use Pyrex for the same reasons. One advantage to using glass is that it can be cleaned completely. I've found that when using plastic the chemicals sometimes etch into the surface and I've been concerned about contamination or steady degredation of the material.
